# openapi commands

Every `openapi` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `openapi:dump`

Dump the OpenAPI document for routes that produce Resource DTO JSON responses.

```bash
bin/semitexa openapi:dump
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--output` | yes |
| `--title` | yes |
| `--api-version` | yes |
